symbols.meaning: Measure: percentage change in the value of the krona against the US dollar, 2022 to 2025.

premises.label: Table 1 quotes the rate as krona per US$, so the value of one krona in US$ is 1 ÷ exchange rate.

Value in 2022 = 1 ÷ 8.40 = US$0.1190 per krona
Value in 2025 = 1 ÷ 7.00 = US$0.1429 per krona
Percentage change = (1 ÷ 7.00 − 1 ÷ 8.40) ÷ (1 ÷ 8.40) × 100
= (8.40 ÷ 7.00 − 1) × 100
= (1.20 − 1) × 100
= 20.00%
Result: the krona appreciated by 20.00% against the US dollar between 2022 and 2025.
